body: Make a small PERSONALITY refinement of this exact existing game character UV atlas. This is an edit of a working texture, NOT a new design. Keep every UV island boundary, layout, spacing, scale, existing face/hair, all base colors and painted fold language EXACTLY unchanged. NO new geometry, no moving islands. Preserve dark background. Only four tiny purposeful changes, coordinates are fractions of image width/height from top left: (1) Existing cream cap badge at x .744-.784, y .191-.214: replace its single black slash by a very simple dark stitched bent return-arrow symbol (a short roof-like chevron connected to a returning hook), 3 broad strokes, readable at tiny size, no letters or numbers, this is a personal embroidered mark not a faction logo. (2) On the large rust-red crown island x .710-.866, y .265-.370, add one small faded warm-gray sewn repair rectangle centered (.797,.303), width .037 height .025, a few irregular ochre stitches, leave existing curved crown seam intact. (3) On the single teal sleeve island centered x .245 y .690, add a muted rusty-copper elbow reinforcement patch centered (.244,.680), width .028 height .043, 4 visibly hand-sewn cream cross stitches, keep entirely inside this island, do NOT repeat on the other sleeve. (4) One dark trouser leg island centered (.627,.65) gets a subtle dark teal knee repair patch width .042 height .030 with only two short warm thread repairs; no skin hole, no matching patch on other leg. Everything else untouched including face and cheeks, scarf not present in this map. Keep these details sparse and worn, no comic badges everywhere, no strong outline, no glow, no photographic scratches or extra grain. The overall matte hand-painted anime game style, rust cap and petrol teal jacket must stay the same. Output the exact same square UV atlas.
gear: Refine this exact working backpack/scarf/charm UV texture atlas with just two personal details, keep ALL existing UV island positions, silhouettes, sizes, gaps, current colors, painted strokes, buckle, seams EXACTLY. Do not redraw the atlas, keep face of every island registered exactly. (1) On the front backpack FLAP, the right large khaki panel in lower right, upper portion around x .760 y .619 from image top-left: add a SMALL faded off-white hand-painted return-home mark, simple roof chevron with a returning hook arrow below, exactly three confident strokes. Size at most .038 image width, .032 image height. Keep buckle and strap unobstructed. It should look worn into fabric rather than a new high-contrast sticker. (2) Existing square repair patch at approximately x .839 y .744 on same front backpack below buckle: retain its exact size, recolor its inner cloth muted rusty terracotta and change the neat stitch border to a few imperfect cream cross stitches. This should echo a rust-colored cap and teal jacket, feel like a well-used personal bag. Leave the orange scarf and ochre charm fully unchanged. Do not add labels, writing, badges elsewhere, extra scratches, extra grime, extra straps, or new isolated shapes in the background. This is a production albedo UV atlas, not an illustration of objects; preserve all material boundaries and layout exactly. Output same square image.
